text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Alright, how about something like this?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Trainer always works so hard to make my training menus, so for once, I thought maybe I could at least suggest something like, 'How about this?'...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: "Ah, but wait. Thinking about it, wouldn't that just increase the amount of training without really changing what I'm already doing...?"

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Urrgh, this won't do!
I need to study way harder,
just like you, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
"...B-Before I knew it, it was morning... In the end,
I spent the whole time just studying..."

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Haaah... So much to think about.
Trainers really are incredible after all.
Thank you so much, as always... Uuu.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Narita Top Road got so absorbed in studying
training methods that she ended up staying up late...
